title: Mindful Ecotherapy Center — E-Learning & Course Certification Platform
brief: An accredited mindfulness institute needed an integrated platform to sell certification courses, provide student portals, and publish academic research.
approach: Built a customized WooCommerce learning management system with self-service student portals, automated certification issuance, and categorized educational publishing.
outcome: Streamlined online course enrollment and automated digital certification delivery for thousands of students worldwide.
